messages:
Priya (People Ops): Quick thread for Aria's hybrid on-site this Wed 10:30am PT — need to lock a few logistics.
Noah (Recruiter): Candidate confirmed travel, arriving 10am PT and prefers quiet room for the first pairing.
Sam K (Hiring Manager): Ill be on the first panel remotely. Whos the on-site host and where do we meet?
Emma (Office): Im covering reception that day. Ill meet Aria at 9:55am, give badge, and walk to Quiet Room B.
Priya (People Ops): Catering: small snack box + tea. Note: Aria flagged gluten-free and halal. Ordered accordingly, labeled. :ok_hand:
IT Helpdesk Bot: Laptop loaner requested. ETA: delivered to Quiet Room B by 9:30am. Image includes interview VM and network restrictions.
Noah (Recruiter): Aria asked if she can bring a short code sample to discuss — allowed?
Sam K (Hiring Manager): Yes, well allow a personal code sample, but no external internet access for the interview environment.
Priya (People Ops): IT will enforce outbound git/network block for the VM. Sam: please confirm test repo is pre-cloned on loaner.
IT Helpdesk Bot: Confirmed: repo mirror present at /home/interview/sample-task, docker image: redwood/interview:staging. Outbound git blocked.
Priya (People Ops): Accessibility note: Aria uses a cane and requested a low-table seating option. Building entrance and elevator access confirmed. 
Emma (Office): Ive flagged the host team and posted signage from reception to Quiet Room B.
Noah (Recruiter): Calendar invites sent to panel + candidate. Remote link + fallback number included.
Sam K (Hiring Manager): Can you add a 15-min interviewer warmup at 10:20am for quick sync? Remote folks will join then.
Priya (People Ops): Added warmup 10:20-10:30. Ill also print a physical schedule and interviewer bios at reception.
Noah (Recruiter): Candidate provided emergency contact and dietary notes; copied to emergency contact field on the invite.
Priya (People Ops): Final checklist: badge printed, loaner ready, snacks labeled, elevator access, guest Slack account created (expires in 14 days). Ill close once everyone confirms.
Sam K (Hiring Manager): Confirmed. Thanks — see you all Wed.
Emma (Office): Will be there early to greet.
IT Helpdesk Bot: Reminder scheduled: run camera/mic check with remote panel at 10:15am PT.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks team. Closing thread.
